statement: Instrument identity must bind issuing authority, full identifier, subject, signature and annex set.
Draft documents with blank numbering cannot activate financial policy.
A catalogue search miss cannot be interpreted as repeal or judicial suspension.
Regulations 01/25 and 02/25 must have independent effective-dated judicial disposition records.
Account-transfer policy must require complete authenticated Article 23–26 and approved interpretation.
External settlement evidence and liability derecognition must require independent accounting authorization.
